text:
evie: Quick check 2: dashboard list cards feel tight on tablet; compact toasts overlap the primary CTA. anyone else seeing this?

noah: saw it on staging. the inline padding token at ~800px is too low.

sam: Could bump card inner inset at tablet breakpoints instead of outer grid gap so list alignment stays stable.

zara: That helps, but toasts are absolutely positioned to the viewport; they still sit on top of CTAs.

evie: Proposal: add a `toast--contextual` modifier that anchors x-offset to the component's content inset. default keeps viewport alignment.

noah: +1. docs note: "use contextual toasts inside confined surfaces (cards, drawers) to avoid covering controls."

sam: Accessibility: ensure button min-height >=44px after padding changes. also verify focus ring distance.

zara: Copy nit: change terse toasts like "Enabled" to "Enabled: alerts" and use sentence case. truncate long names to one line to keep toast height consistent.

design-bot: Canary build shows visual diffs for Card and Toast. preview: https://redwood.design/deploys/176777

evie: PR title: "tablet: increase card inner inset; add contextual toasts; toast copy tweaks"  tagging @noah @sam. Any objections to canary rollout?

noah: none from me, will review the PR.

sam: I'll run keyboard-nav and SR checks for contextual toasts.

zara: I'll look for narrow desktop regressions.

evie: thanks team :thumbsup:
